create_video_generation: create a video from a text prompt using litellm video generation API
test_video_status: test the litellm video status API to check generation progress by video ID
download_video_content: download raw video content bytes from litellm video API by video ID
list_user_videos: list all videos for a user with litellm video list API using pagination
remix_video: remix an existing video with a new text prompt using litellm video remix API
